{{Quote|We were besieged last night. They must have gone for the shuttle, and hit it hard, because at one point an immense fireball erupted over the jungle.|From Doctor Lancer Brunou's journal|<ref name="AOA" />}}
This '''''Curich''-class shuttle''' was part of [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]'s [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. It was assigned to [[Scientist/Legends|science]] team [[MS-133]] and was used to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] the team and its equipment to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aaris III]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to conduct an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] excavation. During the expedition, the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was destroyed while the team was under the influence of the [[Plaque of Victory]]&mdash;a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], inanimate lifeform that induced feelings of paranoia and violence into those beings it came into contact with.

==Description==
This vessel was a [[Curich-class shuttle|''Curich''-class shuttle]]<ref name="AOA" /> constructed by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].<ref name="CC" /> It was capable of [[Transport/Legends|transporting]] up to eighteen personnel and equipment for a [[Standard month/Legends|months]]-long [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeologic]] expedition.<ref name="AOA" />

==History==
One of many [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that were part of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]'s [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]], this ''Curich''-class [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was assigned to [[MS-133]], a [[Scientist/Legends|science]] team that was charged with investigating and documenting the extensive ruins of an extinct civilization&mdash;known as the [[Aaris]]&mdash;on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aaris III]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. Commanded by a [[Unidentified Imperial lieutenant (MS-133)|lieutenant]], the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was used to transport the eighteen-person team and all their equipment from the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], to Aaris III. The vessel was landed in a clearing near a large site of metal ruins, and the team's base camp was set up by the ruins themselves, away from the shuttle.<ref name="AOA" />

The shuttle remained grounded for several months as the team carried out its excavations and explorations. On the sixtieth day of the expedition, the team uncovered a metal ingot known as the [[Plaque of Victory]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] but inanimate lifeform that fed off of the energy of beings in close proximity to it. The Plaque manipulated the minds of these beings, heightening their paranoia and driving them to violent and homicidal acts. The team began to become suspicious of each other and constantly felt like they were being watched by unknown forces in the jungle that surrounded the ruins. Members of the team disappeared, and the base camp came under almost nightly attack<ref name="AOA" /> from the Aaris's primitive descendants<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|154|Jelok}}</ref> wielding [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons. After several [[Death/Legends|deaths]], the expedition leader, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Lancer Brunou]], ordered an evacuation of the planet. One of the scientists, [[Jelok]], disagreed with the Doctor, stating that his work translating [[pictograph]]s in a [[Place of Kastays|chamber]] they had uncovered was reaching a critical juncture. Brunou overruled him, ordering several [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to escort him back to the shuttle. As the rest of the team packed up the base camp, the shuttle was destroyed; the resulting fireball rose high over the jungle canopy. With no escape possible, the survivors of the team created makeshift fortifications, sent out a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]], and awaited rescue.<ref name="AOA" />

The team suffered more casualties<ref name="AOA" /> through attacks by the Aaris<ref name="CSWE" /> until only two survivors&mdash;Brunou and his research assistant, [[Solla Deremot]]&mdash;remained. They were eventually rescued by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'', which had picked up their distress signal and diverted to help them. The crew conducted an investigation into the shuttle's destruction and found that traces of [[Detonite/Legends|detonite]] had been used to blow it up. The [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] section had been completely destroyed, but the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] was relatively intact. The crew salvaged as many spare parts from the wreck as they could with the intention of using them either aboard the ''FarStar'' itself, or one of its support ships.<ref name="AOA" />

==Commanders and crew==
The shuttle was commanded by a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], who was also the vessel's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and leader of MS-133's contingent of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. He was killed on Aaris III during the events that led to the team's decimation.<ref name="AOA" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Curich-class.jpg|thumb|right|A ''Curich''-class shuttle]]
This ''Curich''-class shuttle first appeared in the [[Roleplaying game|RPG adventure]] ''[[Artifact of Aaris]]'', which was published in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' by [[West End Games]]. Although never identified as a ''Curich''-class shuttle in the text&mdash;simply being referred to as a "shuttle"&mdash;one of the images in the adventure clearly shows the wreckage of the vessel to be a ''Curich''-class shuttle.<ref name="AOA" /> The ''Curich''-class appeared in several West End Game products, including ''[[Classic Campaigns]]'', which provided an image of the vessel.<ref name="CC" />

While the adventure implies that MS-133 began turning on one another under the influence of the Plaque of Victory, resulting in deaths to the team's personnel and the destruction of the shuttle,<ref name="AOA" /> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''&mdash;published in [[2008]]&mdash;confirmed that the team came under attack from the remnants of the Aaris civilization.<ref name="CSWE" /> However, since it has not been specifically mentioned that the Aaris were responsible for the destruction of the shuttle, this article does not speculate as to the perpetrators of the explosion.<ref name="AOA" />
